cohort: Children with BBPI attending physiotherapy at a teaching hospital in Nigeria over a 10-year period.
finding: BBPI constituted 8.8% of all cases reviewed at the physiotherapy department, with an average incidence rate of 4.1 per 1,000 live births.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the most common mode of delivery (74.6%), and shoulder dystocia was the most implicated etiology of BBPI (35.2%).
